why: A black dress under a buttoned wool coat is the most fitting and formal choice for an outdoor funeral at level 6–7: the coat covers the bare arms and the dress shoes sit within the formality range. I accept the black near the face, the lack of interest sources and the all-neutral tonal scheme on purpose, because quiet, unadorned black is what mourning asks for and an accent would be wrong. I also accept the coat remarks, since the coat stays buttoned and none of the styling gestures are used.
